card.name: Linking words inside fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: Small words like "the" and "and", or the start of a split medical term, in repeated label phrases. Examples are "lowest effective dose for the shortest duration" and "tramadol hydrochloride and acetaminophen".

modes.label: Linking word in set phrase
modes.description: "the" or "and" inside a stock label phrase about NSAID dosing or the tramadol-acetaminophen product name.
modes.example: the lowest effective dose for<< the>> shortest duration possible should be used.

modes.label: Start of split heart or clot term
modes.description: The opening piece of a long term such as myocarditis or thromboembolism.

card.plain: It marks a small word or word start in a stock label phrase where the next words are highly predictable.
